hints: Scan the DNA string from left to right and keep the current run length.
If a letter matches the previous one, extend the run; otherwise begin a run of length one.
Record the largest run seen, including the first character.
analogy: Count the longest unbroken streak of the same color beads.
example: In ATTCGGGA, the G run has length 3 and is longer than the TT run, so the answer is 3.
algorithm: Maintain a current streak and a maximum while scanning each character once.
correctness: Every same-letter substring is contained in one maximal consecutive run, so the largest run is the longest repetition.
complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space, where n is the string length.
